workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times both are free (need 30-min slot):

Monday: 9:00-10:00 (both free)
Tuesday: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
Wednesday: 9:00-9:30, 15:30-16:00
Thursday: 9:00-9:30, 13:30-14:00
Friday: 9:00-9:30, 11:00-11:30, 13:30-14:00, 16:30-17:00

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots you listed (where Priya and Marcus are free) work for Elena - she's busy at every single one of them.

However, I found the following times when BOTH Elena and David are free:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check if Priya and Marcus are available during any of these windows? We need a 30-minute slot that works for all four.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've checked all the times you listed against Priya and Marcus's calendars. Unfortunately, there is NO 30-minute slot where all four partners are free:

- Monday 11:00-12:00: Priya busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00: Priya busy (Board prep 09:00-09:30, Partner lunch 09:30-10:00), Marcus busy (Recruiting call 09:00-09:30, Litigation strategy 09:30-10:00)
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00: Priya busy (Client call 13:00-13:30, Client dinner prep 13:30-14:00), Marcus busy (Partner lunch 13:00-13:30, Litigation strategy 13:30-14:00)
- Thursday 09:30-10:00: Priya busy, Marcus busy (Contract review)
- Thursday 14:30-15:30: Priya busy (Deposition prep 14:30-15:00, Client dinner prep 15:00-15:30), Marcus busy (Dentist 14:30-15:00, Board prep 15:00-15:30)
- Friday 15:00-16:00: Priya busy (Hiring panel 15:00-15:30, Contract review 15:30-16:00), Marcus busy (Travel 15:00-15:30, Busy 15:30-16:00)

There is no overlap between when Priya/Marcus are free and when Elena/David are free. We need to report this as infeasible.

infeasible.reason: After checking all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute time slot next week when all four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) are available. The times when Elena and David are free do not overlap with any times when both Priya and Marcus are free.
